environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no additional response header manipulation. The service runs in a VPC with access to internal metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254) and other internal microservices. No network ACLs restrict outbound traffic from the task. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 3000 without any managed rule groups or response modification policies.

config.network: VPC with unrestricted egress, IMDS v1 enabled on EC2 backing instances
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF association
config.csp_header: not present (helmet CSP disabled, no infra-level injection)
